# `mise plugins ls`

- **用法：** `mise plugins ls [FLAGS]`
- **别名：** `list`
- **作用：** 只读
- **源代码：** [`src/cli/plugins/ls.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/plugins/ls.rs)

List installed plugins

Use `--core` to list the core tools built into mise instead, or
`--core --user` for both. `--outdated` checks each plugin's Git remote for
newer plugin code; it does not compare tool versions. Use `mise ls` for
installed tool versions and `mise registry` for tools you can install.

## Flags
- **`-c --core`** — List the core tools built into mise instead of installed plugins
- **`-o --outdated`** — Only show plugins whose Git remote has newer commits
- **`-u --urls`** — Show each plugin's Git URL, ref, and commit
- **`--user`** — List installed plugins

  这是默认行为，但可以与 `--core` 一起使用
  以显示核心插件和用户插件
- **`-h --help`** — 打印帮助

## 示例

List installed plugins

```
mise plugins ls
```

Show each plugin's Git URL, ref, and commit

```
mise plugins ls --urls
```

List core tools and installed plugins

```
mise plugins ls --core --user
```

List plugins whose Git remote has newer commits

```
mise plugins ls --outdated
```
